name: Helicone
short: Open-source LLM observability platform and AI gateway with an included free monthly logging and proxy tier.

plans.name: Hobby Plan (Free)
plans.notes: 10,000 requests per month ($0/mo, no credit card required). Generates a Helicone gateway API key to route, proxy, cache, and observe LLM calls locally via https://ai-gateway.helicone.ai.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Higher request caps, custom property tagging, rate-limiting rules, team alerts, and extended analytics data retention.
